manifest.name: Resource Editor
manifest.description: YAML view and editor with diff review, dry run and server-side apply, and new resources from templates or files.

yaml.neatHint: Hide what the cluster maintains: status, managedFields, uid, resourceVersion, generation, timestamps and tool annotations
yaml.reloadHint: Read the object from the cluster again
yaml.editHint: Edit the YAML, review the changes, dry run and apply them
yaml.editHintBanner: Editing the neat YAML. Nothing reaches the cluster before you apply; a dry run validates the changes on the server without saving them.
yaml.reviewHint: Review the changes against the live object. You can still edit on the right; Apply sends only what you changed, and removes what you removed.
yaml.secretHint: The Secret's values are shown as placeholders. Leave a placeholder as it is to keep that value; a value you change or add must be the real one (base64 in data, plain text in stringData).
yaml.discardMessage: Your edits of {{name}} were not applied and will be lost.
yaml.rebasedHint: Your text is now compared with the current version on the server. Apply sends the differences shown, so it also undoes the changes made on the server that your text does not have.
yaml.reloadMessage: Your edits of {{name}} are discarded and the editor starts again from its current version on the server.

apply.conflictTitle: Fields owned by another field manager
apply.conflictHint: The manifest changes fields another field manager (a controller, kubectl, a GitOps tool) set; see the error above. Force apply overwrites them and makes KubeBench their owner, but their manager may set them back.
apply.forceMessage: The fields other field managers own are overwritten with the values of your manifest, and KubeBench becomes their owner.
apply.changedHint: The object was changed (by a controller, another user or a tool) after you started editing, so nothing was applied. Review your changes against its current version, or discard them and reload.

newResource.title: New resource
newResource.namespaceHint: Namespace of the template, and of objects that name none
newResource.importedFrom: Imported from {{files}}. Objects without a namespace go to the namespace selected above.
newResource.hint: Start from a template or import YAML or JSON files (or drop them here); any number of documents. Objects without a namespace go to the namespace selected above.
newResource.drop: Drop YAML or JSON files to import them
newResource.tooLarge: The files are larger than {{size}} MiB, more than one apply can take.
newResource.replaceMessage: The editor holds changes that were not applied. Replacing the text discards them.
